sampling_model.design: Choose \(d\in\mathcal D_L\); the focal design is \(d^\star=u\mathbf 1_p\).
sampling_model.treatment: Each unit receives mutually independent coordinates \(Z_{ai}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(d_i)\), coded as \(X_{ai}=2Z_{ai}-1\).
sampling_model.overlap: Every dosage is interior; no claim is uniform as \(L\downarrow0\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The chosen \(\Sigma_k(d^\star)\) is known from the randomization, so no nuisance is estimated.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: For the additive model with \(k=1\), uniform limited-supply dosage is optimal up to a vanishing finite-sample factor.
Downward-closed hierarchical product designs satisfy an inverse-trace sum over products of marginal inverse-information excesses.
Matrix Chernoff bounds control both extreme eigenvalues of sums of independent bounded positive semidefinite matrices.
Random-design least-squares error separates covariance estimation, approximation, and response-noise contributions.
Volume sampling yields exact pseudoinverse expectations and an unbiased least-squares estimator under dependent subset sampling.

body.tldr: For independent product-Bernoulli assignment and the fixed complete Fourier basis through order \(k\), the population \(A\)-criterion is an explicit elementary-symmetric polynomial. Its unique shared-supply optimizer is the uniform dosage \(u=\min\{L/p,1/2\}\), with an exact criterion value and a sharp global quadratic stability certificate. Exact leverage, a rare-activation rank obstruction, and a two-sided risk theorem show when known-information spectral-threshold OLS attains the population oracle constant at fixed dimension. The product-design trace identity is classical and credited; the contribution is the constrained all-order corollary and its finite-sample package.

project_justification.gap: The modern PFED paper resolves limited supply analytically only for additive responses and reports numerical evidence for interaction models. Classical product-design theory gives the inverse-trace identity but not the shared expected-supply optimizer or the stated risk translation.
project_justification.niche: The fixed dosage-independent Fourier basis makes the criterion sensitive to marginal imbalance, while downward closure permits an exact orthonormal triangular reduction.
project_justification.fill: The project derives the exact all-order criterion, proves uniform dosage with a sharp global modulus, and couples it to exact leverage, rank-failure probability, and unconditional threshold-OLS risk.

body.related_work: Shyamal, Zhang, and Uhler introduce the same product-Bernoulli factorial model and bounded-order Fourier regression, but their limited-supply closed form is additive-only. Schwabe and Wong provide the classical downward-closed product-design inverse-trace identity that is specialized here, so that identity is not presented as new. Tropp supplies the matrix-Chernoff engine for the empirical Gram event. Hsu, Kakade, and Zhang motivate separating Gram conditioning from response noise in random-design regression. Dereziński and Warmuth show that exact inverse-Gram expectations are possible under volume sampling, a dependent design that is not compared as an admissible competitor. Freise and Schwabe and Ravichandran and coauthors study restricted factorial regions or cell allocations under dependent randomization rather than independent coordinate dosage. Yao and coauthors motivate high-multiplicity interaction screens, but their filtered guide-pooling implementation does not verify independent delivery or the homoskedastic Fourier regression used here.
body.technical_internal_limitation: At \(\beta=0\), spectral fallback can make finite-sample truncated risk smaller than the population \(A\)-risk. Thus the exact population optimizer is not asserted to minimize finite-sample risk over designs, and no minimax claim follows from the risk sandwich.
body.honest_scope: The exact population identity, optimizer, stability modulus, leverage, rank obstruction, and fixed-dimensional risk results are to be proved. Exact finite-sample minimax dosage remains open. The core excludes dependent or fixed-count assignment, growing dimension, heteroskedastic outcomes, adaptive rounds, model misspecification, and uniformity as supply vanishes. The Yao application is only an idealized consumer under independent delivery and the stated regression model.
